steps.code:
import datetime

access_token = venmo_login['access_token']
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
all_requests = []
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    all_requests.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

# Define date range: last 7 days including today (2023-06-03)
today = datetime.datetime(2023, 6, 3)
start_date = today - datetime.timedelta(days=6)  # 2023-05-28
start_date = start_date.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
end_date = today.replace(hour=23, minute=59, second=59, microsecond=999999)

total = 0.0
for req in all_requests:
    created = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(req['created_at'])
    if start_date <= created <= end_date:
        total += req['amount']

print(total)
